scope: Selected Protocol armoured missile-use intent: reserve availability for unlabelled legacy ground missiles. Not full armoured behaviour implementation.
sourceIntent: Use available anti-tank missiles in vehicle contact, alongside main weapons. Reference searches weapon/magazine names and vehicle-wide magazines, then requests fire; it does not establish exact loaded station state. Its cover/reverse/manoeuvre workers overlap and are not ported.
cbeGap: GroundFireReady already permits legacy heavy shotMissile ammunition against armour when configured target/domain intent permits it. GroundReload required explicit AP/TANDEMHEAT/HEAT warheadName, so the same unlabelled missile could qualify when loaded but never be proposed from reserve.
implementation: Unlabelled shotMissile reserve ammunition with configured hit>=100 may qualify for armoured target flag512 only when the existing loaded observation has no usable target-suitable result. No class/display-name heuristics.

Existing usage flags, non-air-only/non-laser policy, positive inventory, exact turret, unambiguous compatible muzzle, actual complete native weapon state/reload phase0 and current owner/task/target/ROE/role safeguards remain. No new shots, target/weapon-selection requests or ammunition creation.
Fallback reserve rank0.5 remains below explicit HEAT1/tandem2/AP3. Any usable loaded fallback suppresses the legacy branch; current reload-in-progress refusal remains ahead of proposals.
Uses existing scans and query budgets. Added config comparisons only inside existing compatible positive-reserve candidates. Native acknowledgement and later normal fire admission remain required.

validation.focused: 610 existing operation cases passed; existing reserve-loading case extended, total count unchanged. Static contracts, not simulated native reload.

limits: Configured hit/simulation/usage are ammunition intent, not guidance, penetration, probability of hit, actual weapon effectiveness or balance proof. Unknown warhead rockets/shells are not newly enabled by this reserve fallback.
Air-only and laser-dependent rounds remain excluded from this automatic loading path. Empty same-class magazines retain existing native reload policy; this is not all reserve/loading parity.

No random cover moves, reveal, vehicle-wide selection, per-shot detached workers or physics shortcuts copied. Cover/exposure/relocation and broader Protocol integration remain incomplete; original archive untouched and licensing separate.
Actual modded-station loading, acknowledgement, selection, shots, MP/locality/cancellation and5%median/10%p95 performance remain unverified. Audits paused; no whole-source percentage raised.
